CodeLima 1.0.1 fixes the macOS XProtect false positive reported against the
1.0.0 CLI and preserves embedded terminal use alongside the VM manager.

- Remove the benign string-layout collision that matched Apple's
  FRIENDLYFERRET rule. Darwin packaging now rejects that known collision in
  either executable before creating an archive.
- Restore configurable embedded-tab reordering with Alt+Shift+Left/Right in
  manager focus. Focused shells continue receiving their input unchanged.
- Preserve isolated CodeLima, Lima, and scratch paths through the Linux KVM
  helper, and document the verified nested-host QEMU configuration.
- Correct terminal-read format help and provision the native ABI verifier's
  Python dependency in project-local tooling.

Upgrade with:

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade codelima
codelima daemon update
codelima --version
```

For embedded terminals, run `codelima settings set shell.mode embedded`, open a
node's Shell tab, and use F6 to switch manager/terminal focus. Manual archives
contain both executables; keep them together.

The application test, race, CLI integration, and package gates passed on Linux
and macOS. Real Linux KVM and macOS VZ guest/host terminal checks and a local
Homebrew candidate passed. The active XProtect 5368 rules matched the old CLI
as a positive control and matched neither repaired executable.

This release retains the existing signing and distribution method. Developer
ID notarization, the remaining physical-terminal and fresh-host qualification,
and two existing upstream disabled-glyph test-fixture failures remain tracked
in TODO.md and the installation/terminal QA record.
